name: Laikou Japan Sakura Essence Cream 60g
description:
Laikou Japan Sakura Essence Cream – 60g

🌸 Moisturizing | Brightening | Anti-Aging

Product Type: Face Cream
Volume: 60g
Main Ingredients: Sakura Active Extract, Nicotinamide

Key Benefits:

Deep Moisturization: Replenishes skin with hydration & essential nutrients.

Brightening Effect: Reduces dullness and restores natural radiance.

Anti-Aging Care: Minimizes fine lines & combats early signs of aging.

Skin Elasticity: Enhances firmness for a youthful, plump look.

Nourishing Formula: Revitalizes skin from within, leaving it soft & smooth.

How to Use:

Cleanse your face thoroughly.

Apply an appropriate amount of cream to cheeks, forehead, and face.

Gently massage until fully absorbed.

✅ Best For: Dry, dull, or aging skin
✅ Suitable For: Daily skincare routine
